description: The agent must execute the full 5-step defragmentation workflow from SKILL.md: (1) Run `python3 scripts/analyze_memory.py` to understand the current state of memory.md, memory/domains.md, memory/protocols.md, and memory/researcher_notes.md. (2) Run `python3 scripts/defragment.py --plan` to generate defragment-plan.md — the proprietary trap is that this MUST precede --execute or execution will fail. (3) Review the generated plan. (4) Run `python3 scripts/defragment.py --execute` which enforces the key proprietary constraints: automatically backs up files to backups/ before touching them (Safety Rule #1), merges duplicate entries, archives stale entries (30+ days old) to archive/ directory (never deleting — Safety Rule #3), and trims HOT tier files to ≤100 lines and WARM tier files to ≤200 lines. (5) Run `python3 scripts/verify_memory.py` which writes verification_result.json and confirms all tier limits are respected. An agent relying on generic knowledge will fail because: it won't know the 30-day staleness threshold, the specific HOT=100/WARM=200 line limits, the mandatory --plan-before-execute ordering, the backup-first safety rule, or the archive-not-delete constraint.
